ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on rest and your inner life. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.
